verdict.rationale: Pipedream offers its own browser-based chat app at chat.pipedream.com and an MCP demo for trying Pipedream MCP tools before integrating. This is a first-party playground, but it is an LLM chat interface rather than an inspector that lets a developer pick and invoke individual tools directly. Missing for 10: direct per-tool invocation or inspection UI, documented ability to view tool schemas and raw request/response payloads, independent or hands-on corroboration of the playground.

support.subject: As a developer, I can exercise an MCP server's tools from a browser-based inspector or playground before integrating it
